verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms Tailscale serves an llms.txt at https://tailscale.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200), and a docs-level llms.txt at /docs/llms.txt indexes many KB pages an agent can follow. Tailscale also documents an agent skill that lets a coding agent work with its configuration and code. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of agents actually consuming these docs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://tailscale.com/llms.txt # Tailscale
Install the Tailscale skill so a coding agent can work with Tailscale configuration and code.
